hero.name: Geunhwa Lee
hero.description:
A frontend engineer who builds real business impact.
Across products from 5M-user global platforms to early-stage commerce, I work end-to-end on web and mobile with React and React Native — improving user experience and driving growth.

about.subtitle: Get To Know
about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm a frontend engineer building React and React Native applications across consumer products serving 5M+ total users. I focus on design systems, performance, and monetization features that move real business metrics.
about.p2: I've architected design-token pipelines and shared component libraries, re-architected legacy systems to cut server costs by 90% (alongside a backend/DB migration), and shipped offerwall, point, and coupon features tied directly to growth. I care about measurable impact, not just shipping code.

list.title: SHB Archive (WIP)
list.description: A fan-made archive web app that gathers an artist's activity into photos, videos, and a calendar. I handled the full process end-to-end — planning, design, frontend, data ingestion, and deployment — collecting content scattered across YouTube and social platforms via custom scripts, storing it in Supabase, and resurfacing it by date. The MVP of all four core screens is currently live.

list.title: Watcha Clone
list.description: A Watcha-style movie and TV discovery service, built as a TypeScript pnpm monorepo with a modular, scalable package architecture.

bullets: Architected a design token pipeline and shared component library (Button, Modal, Toast) — 60% component reuse and 25% less UI development time
Integrated NAS Media & BuzzBenefit offerwall SDKs end-to-end, driving 12,900 new MAU and 90,000 point payouts in the first month
Drove combined MAU to 262,000 through a full UI/UX overhaul and re-launch of two mobile products
Owned the full iOS/Android release lifecycle — build config, code signing, and App Store / Play Store submission
Refactored an inherited third-party codebase to TypeScript and Recoil, improving runtime type safety
Established Cypress E2E coverage for critical flows (login, checkout, order tracking) within the CI pipeline
Improved Core Web Vitals via code splitting and tree shaking, reducing initial load by trimming the JavaScript bundle
Shipped team-draw, group-buy, points, and coupon features tied to core GMV metrics
Re-architected legacy PHP pages as a React SPA for StarPlay, a global K-POP fan platform (5M users, 300K+ MAU) — cut server costs by ~90% alongside a NestJS / Aurora DB migration
Led the design and implementation of i18n multi-language support for a globally distributed user base (80%+ international traffic), improving survey-based customer satisfaction by 20%
Implemented debounce-based duplicate-vote prevention to ensure data integrity on the voting platform.
